findings.evidence: The proof assigns inverse-Jacobian factors to contravariant slots and Jacobian factors to covariant slots. Under the assigned consumer’s convention, upper slots are evaluated on coordinate covectors and contribute the Jacobian; lower slots are evaluated on coordinate vectors and contribute the inverse Jacobian. The assigned lem-gr-tensor-component-transformation-law derives these factors, and Lee, Introduction to Smooth Manifolds, 2nd ed., Ch. 11, equations (11.6)–(11.7), confirms the vector and covector component changes ([source PDF](https://julianchaidez.net/materials/reu/lee_smooth_manifolds.pdf)). This proof step does not establish the correct tensor transition maps needed by the assigned consumer.
